controls.authentication: not-applicable: CI-only read-only tooling; runner identity is repository read access and never a production user session.
controls.authorization: not-applicable: CI tooling has no business object authority or production credentials; repository reviewers authorize policy changes.
controls.currentPermissions: not-applicable: No persisted business grants are consumed; workflow permissions are independently constrained and tested.
controls.origin: not-applicable: No HTTP entry or browser cookies are accepted; the input is a local checkout on an isolated runner.
controls.rateLimit: not-applicable: No public request endpoint exists; the workflow uses an explicit ten-minute execution timeout and bounded subprocess output.
controls.schema: not-applicable: This read-only CI tool has no HTTP payload Schema; its policy and scanner report checks are covered by dedicated unit tests.
controls.bodyLimit: not-applicable: No HTTP body is consumed; git source reads use a 32 MiB subprocess output limit and only repository-tracked source paths.
controls.responseLimit: not-applicable: No business response or export is emitted; the gate prints finding identifiers and status without source snippets.
controls.cache: not-applicable: The scanner has no shared data cache; PR checkout does not persist repository credentials or production data.
controls.sensitiveData: not-applicable: The tool emits finding identifiers and statuses, not business records or credential values; no PII transformation occurs.
controls.audit: not-applicable: This scanner does not mutate auditable business state; it reports its outcomes through ordinary CI logs.
controls.stateMachine: not-applicable: Read-only checks do not mutate business state, user grants, migrations or production services.

controls.authentication: not-applicable: This BFF does not authenticate users or validate service credentials. It replaces browser Authorization with the runtime service header and forwards cookies only in trusted mode; the API validates the service identity and current user session.
controls.authorization: not-applicable: Feature, object and field authorization belongs to the API on every request. The BFF only permits explicitly declared path/method capabilities; a permitted path never grants access to its business object.
controls.currentPermissions: not-applicable: The BFF neither caches nor evaluates persisted grants. The API reloads current account, session and object grants; forwarding a cookie cannot preserve a revoked permission.
controls.rateLimit: not-applicable: Business rate limits and sensitive export throttles are enforced by the API, which receives only the configured verified ingress IP. The BFF does not introduce an independent user quota.
controls.schema: not-applicable: Business JSON, query and multipart schemas are validated by the API. This relay preserves the stream and query and does not deserialize or invent a second business request schema.
controls.bodyLimit: not-applicable: The BFF streams the request without buffering it. API upload and command readers enforce their actual byte limits; the existing upload relay retains its concurrency and timeout bounds.
controls.responseLimit: not-applicable: API queries and exports enforce their record and file bounds before release. This relay streams the response and only pre-reads the official download signature; it does not build an unbounded business result.
controls.sensitiveData: not-applicable: Business field filtering, redaction and PII scope are enforced by the API. The BFF preserves authorized bytes, never forwards browser Authorization, excludes untrusted headers, and does not persist roster contents; its private response cache policy is evidenced separately.
controls.audit: not-applicable: Durable business audit is written transactionally by the API before official list or export bytes are released. The BFF does not mutate business state or duplicate the API audit ledger.
controls.stateMachine: not-applicable: Version checks, replay rules and award state transitions are owned by API commands. The BFF forwards writes once and does not retry or implement a second mutation state machine.

controls.authentication: not-applicable: The page proxy is not a session authenticator. API reads and commands validate current user sessions; the proxy only forwards trusted cookies, and its CSRF cookie is a nonce rather than authentication evidence.
controls.authorization: not-applicable: Page access policy is delegated to the API web/access endpoint and business object/field checks remain in API reads and commands. Successful page handoff is not a grant of data access.
controls.currentPermissions: not-applicable: No business grant snapshot is cached in this page proxy. API endpoints reload current user and object permissions; this proxy cannot reinstate a revoked grant.
controls.origin: not-applicable: This page gate does not consume business mutation bodies. Its access lookup is read-only and redirects or issues a same-site CSRF nonce; business write Origin/CSRF checks remain in the BFF and API.
controls.rateLimit: not-applicable: The proxy performs one API access lookup with its existing ten-second deadline. Business and service rate controls belong to API/ingress; this change adds no request loop, retry or independent quota.
controls.schema: not-applicable: The proxy consumes no business JSON or multipart input. It encodes the page pathname into a fixed API access URL; runtime transport configuration validation remains unchanged.
controls.bodyLimit: not-applicable: The page proxy does not read, buffer or deserialize the incoming request body. API command and upload entry points continue to enforce actual body limits.
controls.responseLimit: not-applicable: The proxy does not forward the API gate body or return business records. It returns fixed denial text, a redirect or an empty NextResponse.next handoff; page/API producers own their response bounds.
controls.sensitiveData: not-applicable: The proxy does not produce a roster or transform business PII. Its API call uses allowlisted forwarded headers and discards the gate body; page/API consumers retain their own field filtering and redaction duties.
controls.audit: not-applicable: This page access gate does not mutate auditable business state. Durable business event and export audit remains owned by the API; CSRF nonce issuance is not an award mutation.
controls.stateMachine: not-applicable: The proxy does not execute award corrections, exports or other business transitions. It hands off the page after an API policy check and never retries business commands.
